title: Pre-midi amplitude-envelope execution plan v1
description: An ephemeral interpretation of existing synth patch envelope fields. Does not change .premidi v7/v8 or patch v1 persistence. Implemented slice only; oscillator/filter/voice-host contracts are future work.

x-scheduling.clock: absolute audio seconds, independent of UI clocks and device sample rates
x-scheduling.same_time_order: array order; stable event.order breaks timestamp ties; never sort by kind
x-scheduling.linear: ramp from the preceding event value/time to this event value/time; target is evaluated continuously then sampled by the backend
x-scheduling.before_first_event: voice input must be silent or gain initialized to zero
x-scheduling.after_last_event: hold legacy gain floor 0.000001 until source termination at off + release + 0.012 seconds
x-scheduling.note_duration: current synth scheduler clamps gate to at least 0.015 seconds; the envelope planner accepts shorter positive gates for other hosts and qualification fixtures
x-scheduling.zero_decay: instant sustain step at attack completion is intentional legacy behavior
x-scheduling.control: patch envelope fields are snapshotted when the voice plan is made; no mid-note mutation or automation support is claimed
x-scheduling.compatibility: unknown execution-plan versions must be rejected; no migration of stored patches is needed for this behavior-preserving slice
